title: Falcarindiol Isolated from Notopterygium incisum Inhibits the Quorum Sensing of Pseudomonas aeruginosa.
authors: Zhao, Chaoyue; Zheng, Hongda; Zhou, Liman; Ji, Hongrui; Zhao, Lu; Yu, Wengong; Gong, Qianhong
one_liner_zh: 该文研究天然化合物Falcarindiol抑制铜绿假单胞菌群体感应，涉及转录因子LasR与DNA启动子结合抑制及分子对接，但对象为细菌非TF-DNA典型体系，方法仅简单对接，深度不足。
abstract: Quorum sensing (QS) is employed by the opportunistic pathogen Pseudomonas aeruginosa to regulate physiological behaviors and virulence. QS inhibitors (QSIs) are potential anti-virulence agents for the therapy of P. aeruginosa infection. During the screening for QSIs from Chinese herbal medicines, falcarindiol (the major constituent of Notopterygium incisum) exhibited QS inhibitory activity. The subinhibitory concentration of falcarindiol exerted significant inhibitory effects on the formation of biofilm and the production of virulence factors such as elastase, pyocyanin, and rhamnolipid. The mRNA expression of QS-related genes (lasB, phzH, rhlA, lasI, rhlI, pqsA, and rhlR) was downregulated by falcarindiol while that of lasR was not affected by falcarindiol. The transcriptional activation of the lasI promoter was inhibited by falcarindiol in the P. aeruginosa QSIS-lasI selector. Further experiments confirmed that falcarindiol inhibited the las system using the reporter strain Escherichia coli MG4/pKDT17. Electrophoretic mobility shift assay (EMSA) showed that falcarindiol inhibited the binding of the transcription factor LasR and the lasI promoter region. Molecular docking showed that falcarindiol interacted with the Tyr47 residue, leading to LasR instability. The decrease of LasR-mediated transcriptional activation was responsible for the reduction of downstream gene expression, which further inhibited virulence production. The inhibition mechanism of falcarindiol to LasR provides a theoretical basis for its medicinal application.
abstract_zh: 群体感应（quorum sensing, QS）是机会性病原体铜绿假单胞菌（*Pseudomonas aeruginosa*）调控生理行为和毒力的机制。QS抑制剂（QSIs）是治疗铜绿假单胞菌感染的潜在抗毒力药物。在对中草药进行QSIs筛选过程中，法卡林二醇（*Notopterygium incisum*的主要成分）表现出QS抑制活性。亚抑制浓度的法卡林二醇对生物膜形成及弹性蛋白酶、绿脓菌素和鼠李糖脂等毒力因子的产生具有显著抑制作用。法卡林二醇下调了QS相关基因（*lasB*、*phzH*、*rhlA*、*lasI*、*rhlI*、*pqsA*和*rhlR*）的mRNA表达，而*lasR*的表达未受法卡林二醇影响。在铜绿假单胞菌QSIS-*lasI*选择子中，法卡林二醇抑制了*lasI*启动子的转录激活。进一步实验使用报告菌株大肠杆菌（*Escherichia coli*）MG4/pKDT17证实，法卡林二醇抑制了*las*系统。电泳迁移率变动分析（EMSA）显示，法卡林二醇抑制了转录因子LasR与*lasI*启动子区域的结合。分子对接显示，法卡林二醇与Tyr47残基相互作用，导致LasR不稳定。LasR介导的转录激活降低是下游基因表达减少的原因，进而抑制了毒力产生。法卡林二醇对LasR的抑制机制为其药用应用提供了理论基础。
